fields.summary_ko.0: Advantest Corp (TYO:6857) achieved 1H net profit increase of 117% to JPY 36.81 billion ($2.33 billion) as semiconductor test equipment demand surged with increasing AI demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: The company raised FY2027 revenue guidance from JPY 1.714 trillion to JPY 1.863 trillion, and net profit from JPY 66.0 billion to JPY 74.15 billion.
fields.summary_ko.2: The semiconductor market in 2026 is expected to achieve strong growth centered on AI applications, with the semiconductor tester market forecast to reach historical highs.
